mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate rise above 5.5% signals economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 12-month moving averages signal broad economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both below 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO are below their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In high GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 > 3% annualized), rising housing starts (HOUST) above the 6-month average signals sustained consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 3% and HOUST rises above 6-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production level above 105 indicates robust manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 235.0 (annualized inflation > 3.5%) triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) falling below 138,000 signals labor market weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS is below 138000.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained retail sales above 430,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 430,000) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS exceeds 430,000.
